faq.headline: Law Firm Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your law firm site.

items.question: Does a contact form create an attorney-client relationship?
items.answer: No. Explain your intake process and add a legal notice reviewed by your firm.

items.question: Can I post past case results?
items.answer: Only publish results you are allowed to disclose, with context required by applicable advertising rules.

items.question: Can visitors request a consultation?
items.answer: Yes. Collect an enquiry and let your team confirm availability and next steps.

items.question: Can prospective clients send confidential case details?
items.answer: A general website form should collect only basic contact and matter-type information. Tell visitors not to send confidential documents or sensitive details before your firm establishes a secure process.

items.question: What should an attorney profile include?
items.answer: Use verified credentials, jurisdictions, practice areas, and experience approved by the attorney. Follow the professional advertising rules that apply to your firm.

items.question: Can I explain what happens after a consultation request?
items.answer: Yes. Describe your intake steps and how your team will respond. A request does not confirm an appointment or create an attorney-client relationship.
